sentence: This project studies how types of dendritic cells control the responses of cytotoxic T cells inside the tumor microenvironment.
This project uses mouse disease models to find out how nerve cells in the intestinal wall form distinct neuron types.
This project studies the role of chromosome 17q gain in how neuroblastoma tumors form and become malignant.
This project develops ways to help engineered immune cells bind to or get through the glycocalyx coating that protects cancer cells in solid tumors.
This project studies how cell metabolism controls T cells in early childhood and how they respond to the childhood cancer neuroblastoma.
This project studies how gene variants relate to acute kidney injury in sickle cell disease and builds a machine learning tool to predict it.
This project studies how genetics, inflammation, and alpha-synuclein accumulation contribute to Parkinson's disease that starts early in life.
This project uses molecular profiling to study inflammatory mediators linked to cardiovascular risk in people with chronic kidney disease.
This project offers parents targeted sequencing of their children at different points in development to find inherited genetic conditions doctors can act on.
This project studies how lipid nanoparticles trigger immune responses by disrupting endosomes, and which stromal cells sense that response.
This project develops treatments for triple negative breast cancer using plant virus nanoparticles, and studies how they work in mouse models and canine patients.
This project tries to find out how fibrosis and emphysema develop in cigarette smokers with chronic lung diseases.
This project builds and tests a decision support tool that predicts survival in adults and children with pulmonary arterial hypertension.
This project studies how a type of T cell affects plaque inflammation and why atherosclerosis resists regression in type 2 diabetes.
This project builds machine learning models that judge whether air medical evacuations are appropriate in rural Alaska, using health records and community-engaged qualitative methods.
This project works to bring advances in cellular and gene therapy into the treatment of cancer.
This project studies how cancer dependency genes and pathways drive the growth and spread of osteosarcoma.
This project studies how developmental exposure to a mixture affects the immune system during respiratory virus infection.
This project develops and tests gene editing strategies to repair mutations that cause osteogenesis imperfecta, using a bone-targeting virus.
This project focuses on tumor immunology, tumor immunotherapy, and stem cell transplant immunology.
